Why offer vegetarian burger?
Oct 2019 • Family
The restaurant locations are fun and nice, and beer selection is decent (not as good as Pasteur or HOD). I mostly went because I am a huge fan of the Beyond Meat Burger and this is the only place I know that imports it. It was a slow progression of finding out the bun wasn’t vegan and no alternative (brought my own bread after) to finding out the fries aren’t vegetarian. All of that would be fine, nowhere should have to cater to vegans, but why even offer this expensive (delicious) imported plant burger and then make it in a way that we can’t eat? Believe it or not, vegetarians want fries too! Anyway to alter this? If so, I’ll be back once a week...was spending well over a million each visit for all the food and beers.

Boutique decor, fine food and beer
Nov 2019 • Friends
We (6people) went here for a Friday after-work-night. The location is easy to find, and the parking lot is available (not a pain as most of restaurants in the central districts of HCMC).
The decoration is coherence and suitable for multiple needs with both inside area (with air conditioner) and outside one for anyone who want to enjoy the fresh air (at least when the weather in HCMC is not so hot). You can also choose either table (small) for 4-6 people or bar-type seat (for street view).

Food: my favourite aspect of this place. Side dishes and main ones are well seasoned. Be careful with the spicy chicken wings though, they could be a hell of a test for your tongue!

Drinks: they have a really long list of beers, both local produced or imported. Some signatures/specials have twisted funny names to choose. Come with those are wide price range also.

In general, the price could be a little high for locals but quite the same with other craft beer restaurants in District 1.
